patterns.name: Evidence-First Memory
patterns.description: Store reusable knowledge with source provenance, confidence, audit logs, and rollback state instead of relying on unsupported recollection.
patterns.agent_rule: When durable memory affects future behavior, preserve source evidence, confidence, and change history.
patterns.runtime_rule: Require source/capture identifiers and audited change sets for graph or skill updates.

patterns.name: Progressive Skill Disclosure
patterns.description: Expose a concise skill trigger first, then load detailed references, scripts, or assets only when needed.
patterns.agent_rule: Keep skill entrypoints small and push bulky context into references or tools.
patterns.runtime_rule: Skill installers should preserve metadata, references, and verification scripts separately.

failure_modes.name: Unsupported Memory Write
failure_modes.description: A system stores a durable lesson without enough source evidence, confidence metadata, or rollback path.
failure_modes.detection: Memory notes, graph edges, or generated skills lack source IDs, evidence IDs, audit records, or change-set metadata.
failure_modes.mitigation: Use capture, provisional graph updates, audited change sets, and rollback before promoting graph knowledge into skills or policies.

agent_practices.name: Capture Before Graph
agent_practices.trigger: A web page, paper, repo, or local document should become durable Praxis knowledge.
agent_practices.practice: Capture the source first, then auto-apply provisional graph relationships with evidence and an audited rollback path.
agent_practices.anti_pattern: Directly adding graph edges or skills from a raw web page without preserved evidence, confidence metadata, or change history.
